title: Level structures on tropical abelian varieties
summary: We introduce level structures on tropical abelian varieties and give a modular interpretation of $A_g[m]^{\mathrm{trop}}$, the tropicalization of the moduli space $\mathcal{A}_g[m]$ of principally polarized abelian varieties with level $m$ structure. We study the case of abelian surfaces in greater depth. The link of $A_2[m]^{\mathrm{trop}}$ is an explicit simplicial complex whose vertices are the primitive vectors of $(\mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z})^4$ up to sign.
